## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature (event type, connector, provider, strategy, ...)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor / internal
- [ ] Benchmark / evaluation

## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check src tests` passes
- [ ] `ruff format --check src tests` passes
- [ ] `mypy` passes
- [ ] `pytest` passes and new code has meaningful tests
- [ ] Public behavior changes are documented (`docs/` and/or `README.md`)
- [ ] I did **not** commit secrets, credentials, or real customer data
- [ ] Any synthetic data added is clearly labeled synthetic

## Research integrity (if this touches benchmarks/evaluation)

- [ ] Results are reported honestly, including cases where FinIR does worse
- [ ] No hand-tuning of labels to flatter the framework
